domain-information: A Business Owner submits a certification application to request evaluation of their company.
A Business Owner uploads compliance documents to show their company meets required standards.
An Audit Coordinator reviews a certification application to assign a qualified auditor.
An Audit Coordinator schedules an on-site audit to ensure the business can be inspected properly.
An Auditor evaluates compliance documents to identify areas needing deeper investigation.
An Auditor performs an on-site audit to verify the business follows its documented processes.
An Auditor submits an audit report to summarise findings for the certification board and the compliance officer.
A Certification Board Member reviews an audit report to determine whether the company meets certification criteria.
A Certification Board Member issues a certification decision to approve or reject the application.
A Compliance Officer handles follow-up messaging to help businesses correct issues identified during an audit.
A Compliance Officer schedules an evaluation meeting with the business owner to discuss the audit.

associations.description: Business Owner creates the Certification Application to begin the process
Audit Coordinator checks the Certification Application to assign an auditor
Audit Coordinator assigns an Auditor to the case
Auditor reviews each Compliance Document for compliance issues
Auditor performs the On Site Audit at the company
Auditor creates the Audit Report after finishing the checks
Audit Report is passed to the Compliance Officer for follow up
Certification Board Member reviews the Audit Report to make a decision
Certification Board Member issues the Certification Decision
Certification Decision is tied to the Certification Application as its result
Compliance Officer sends Follow Up Messaging to guide improvements
Compliance Officer sets up the Evaluation Meeting with the business
Business Owner receives the Follow Up Messaging for next steps
Business Owner joins the Evaluation Meeting to review issues
